summary: Prefer a configurable two-BTC-block mining anchor gap under UIP-0018
details: Select exact committed historical indexer state for mining, yielding to the parent anchor and its checkpoint reuse limit. Difficulty and rewards remain bound to the selected historical profile.
Keep the observed latest state separate from the selected anchor for work refresh; failed historical queries remain retryable without searching other heights.

Add --miner.usdb-anchor-gap and Eth.Miner.USDB.AnchorGap. Omitted settings use 2; explicit zero selects latest and survives TOML round trips. Validator acceptance rules and network identities are unchanged.

Cover historical RPC identity, activation boundaries, mixed-gap recovery, work refresh and real Ethash block preparation/finalization in local regression tests. Node-kit UI integration and independent multi-node gap measurements remain separate work.
operator_actions: The new geth default may delay use of newly committed pass or balance changes. Keep the recommended gap unless intentionally overriding the local mining strategy; existing indexer data and mining authorization are retained.
